## Definition of done

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit -p .`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] End-to-end suite: no guard regression against the baseline; this item's targets are green
- [ ] Checked on phone, tablet and laptop (preview or local build); screenshots or a recording attached for visible changes
- [ ] No live form was submitted while testing; no `.env` committed
- [ ] CLAUDE.md updated if the architecture changed
